$comment: Type led covers, owner decision D283 (R285-WEB-TRANSFORMATION-WT-D, 2026-10-22). ONE source for the blog, /resources/ and the per post social card. TypeCover.astro draws the page cover from it and scripts/generate-og-images.js draws /Assets/og/blog-<slug>.png from it, so the two cannot drift. Colours are NAMES of --cover-* role tokens in astro/src/styles/tokens.css, never values. A motif is SVG on a 100 by 100 box, painted only through var(--tc-ink), var(--tc-sub) and var(--tc-accent), which the generator resolves from the same tokens. A post with no entry under posts still gets a cover: its title is the line and its category picks the family. A line here carries no comma or colon: satori sets trailing punctuation as its own segment and opens a visible gap before it on the social card.
